newsitem.title: USA: El Salvador seeks PL-480 cottonseed oil, sunoil.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador seeks PL-480 cottonseed oil, sunoil.

text.p: El Salvador said it was seeking about 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk and about 750 to 1,250 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent International Services Corp said.
Offers are to be received by July 29 and remain valid until July 30.
The shipment dates for both commodities were slated for September 10-25.
Contracts will be awarded on the basis of maximum five percent less at buyer's option.
